title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The audio contains spoken Korean, “여러분 안녕하세요!”, directly violating the no-talking requirement.
The ending contains an extra line of garbled black text beneath “Shop now”, making the final card look unfinished.
A partial white marking appears on the bottle in the 9.4-second close-up that is not visible on the supplied product.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical studio ad preserves the bottle and required captions, but unwanted speech and garbled ending text require a redo.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is identified as a 15-second MP4, and the frames have a 9:16 vertical format.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The black cylindrical body, tapered shoulder, broad screw cap, and raised loop-style lid closely match the reference.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The samples show full-bottle views and lid close-ups at different orientations against a clean neutral studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: Both phrases are clearly readable and spelled exactly as requested in the opening and ending samples.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound transcript confirms spoken voice; the music's presence and mood cannot be determined from the transcript.
